per_sample.text: Gia đình Tôi bữa tối là lúc cả nhà gần gũi nhau nhất trong ngày, vì nó rất đặc biệt sau một ngày làm việc vất vả cả nhà mới được sum hợp vui vẻ, trò chuyện.
per_sample.question: Có phải bữa tối là lúc cả nhà gần gũi nhau nhất trong ngày? Nếu đúng, vì sao nó đặc biệt như vậy?
label: នៅក្នុងគ្រួសាររបស់ខ្ញុំ អាហារពេលល្ងាចគឺជាពេលវេលាដ៏កៀកបំផុតនៃថ្ងៃសម្រាប់គ្រួសារទាំងមូល ព្រោះវាពិសេសណាស់បន្ទាប់ពីការងារមួយថ្ងៃដ៏លំបាក នៅពេលដែលគ្រួសារទាំងមូលអាចជួបជុំគ្នាយ៉ាងសប្បាយរីករាយ និងជជែកកំសាន្ត។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ក្រុមគ្រួសារខ្ញុំ អាហារពេលល្ងាចជាពេលដែលគ្រួសារទាំងអស់នៅជិតគ្នាអស់មួយថ្ងៃ ព្រោះវាពិសេសណាស់ បន្ទាប់ពីមួយថ្ងៃធ្វើការ ធ្វើឲ្យគ្រួសារទាំងអស់បានជួបជុំសប្បាយរីករាយនិងនិយាយគ្នា។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Trong gia đình tôi, bữa cơm tối là thời điểm gần gũi nhất trong ngày cho cả gia đình, vì nó rất đặc biệt sau một ngày làm việc vất vả, khi cả gia đình có thể quây quần bên nhau vui vẻ và trò chuyện thoải mái.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the general core message: in the speaker's family, dinner is special because after a day of work the family can gather happily and talk. However, there are notable semantic distortions. The phrase "គ្រួសារទាំងអស់" means more like "all families" rather than "the whole family," which changes the intended referent. The phrase "នៅជិតគ្នាអស់មួយថ្ងៃ" suggests being close together for the whole day, whereas the reference means dinner is the closest/intimate moment of the day. The detail "វất vả" / "ដ៏លំបាក" meaning a hard or tiring workday is omitted. The message is recoverable but not fully faithful.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The possessive expression "ខ្ញុំ" for "my" is appropriate and natural enough in "ក្រុមគ្រួសារខ្ញុំ." There are no religious honorifics or Khmer Krom-specific kinship terms required here. However, the repeated use of "គ្រួសារទាំងអស់" is pragmatically and referentially imprecise, because it implies multiple families rather than all members of one family. This is more a referential noun-phrase issue than a severe pronoun failure.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis does not contain fake phonetic transliterations or raw Vietnamese copied into Khmer script. Vocabulary such as "អាហារពេលល្ងាច," "ពិសេសណាស់," "ធ្វើការ," "ជួបជុំ," "សប្បាយរីករាយ," and "និយាយគ្នា" is legitimate Khmer. Lexical choices are mostly valid, though "និយាយគ្នា" is less expressive than "ជជែកកំសាន្ត" and "គ្រួសារទាំងអស់" is semantically awkward in context.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is understandable but contains awkward Khmer phrasing. "អាហារពេលល្ងាចជាពេលដែល..." is acceptable, but "គ្រួសារទាំងអស់នៅជិតគ្នាអស់មួយថ្ងៃ" has unnatural word order and an unintended temporal reading. "បន្ទាប់ពីមួយថ្ងៃធ្វើការ ធ្វើឲ្យ..." is also somewhat clumsy and less fluent than the reference structure. Overall, the syntax is serviceable but not native-like.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a mediocre-to-acceptable translation with the main idea still recoverable, but it contains several non-trivial semantic and syntactic problems. The strongest area is lexical legitimacy, since there is no fake transliteration. The weakest areas are semantic fidelity and morpho-syntactic flow, especially due to the mistranslation of 'whole family' as 'all families,' the temporal distortion of 'closest moment of the day' into 'close together all day,' and the omission of the hardship of the workday.

per_sample.text: Nếu được dạy lại một món ăn truyền thống Khmer, tôi sẽ chọn học cách làm Num banh chok Khmer (Bún nước lèo Khmer). Đây là món ăn với sự kết hợp hương vị độc đáo và cách chế biến tinh tế.
per_sample.question: Nếu được dạy lại một món ăn truyền thống, bạn muốn học món nào trước?
label: បើបានរៀនធ្វើម្ហូបខ្មែរបុរាណវិញខ្ញុំនឹងជ្រើសរើសរៀនធ្វើនំបញ្ចុកខ្មែរមុនគេ។នេះជាមុខម្ហូបដែលមានរសជាតិប្លែកនិងវិធីធ្វើដ៏សប្បាយរីករាយ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អេីយបើគេបង្រៀនខ្ញុំធ្វេីម្ហូបខ្មែរត្រជាក់មួយទៀត ខ្ញុំនឹងជ្រើសយករៀនធ្វេីនំបញ្ចុកខ្មែរ។ នេះជាអាហារដែលមានការរួមបញ្ចូលរសជាតិពិសេស និងវិធីធ្វេីដ៏ល្អិតល្អន់។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Nếu được học nấu món Khmer cổ truyền, tôi sẽ chọn học làm bún nước lèo Khmer trước tiên. Đây là món ăn có hương vị độc đáo và cách làm rất thú vị.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the broad communicative intent: the speaker would choose to learn how to make Khmer num banh chok, and the dish is described as having a special flavor combination and a refined preparation method. However, there is a significant semantic error where 'món ăn truyền thống Khmer' / 'ម្ហូបខ្មែរបុរាណ' is rendered as 'ម្ហូបខ្មែរត្រជាក់' meaning 'cold Khmer food/dish,' which distorts the cultural category of a traditional Khmer dish. The added interjection 'អើយ' is not present in the source/reference and slightly changes tone. The core dish name and second-sentence meaning remain mostly recoverable.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of 'ខ្ញុំ' for the first-person speaker is appropriate and neutral. The generic 'គេបង្រៀនខ្ញុំ' is acceptable for 'if someone/one teaches me,' though it is slightly more explicit than the reference's passive-like phrasing. There are no major violations of Khmer/Krom social hierarchy, kinship, or religious honorific protocol in this sentence.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis does not rely on fake phonetic transliteration. 'នំបញ្ចុកខ្មែរ' is an authentic Khmer lexical item for the culturally specific dish. Words such as 'រសជាតិពិសេស,' 'រួមបញ្ចូល,' and 'ល្អិតល្អន់' are legitimate Khmer expressions. The main lexical problem is not fake transliteration but the incorrect lexical choice 'ត្រជាក់' for 'traditional/បុរាណ.'
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally understandable, but the flow is somewhat awkward. 'អើយបើ...' is pragmatically odd at the beginning of this formal explanatory sentence. 'ជ្រើសយករៀនធ្វើ' is comprehensible but less natural than the reference's 'ជ្រើសរើសរៀនធ្វើ.' The phrase 'ម្ហូបខ្មែរត្រជាក់មួយទៀត' is syntactically possible but semantically and collocationally unnatural in context.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the translation is usable and conveys much of the intended message, especially the selection of Khmer num banh chok and the idea of a distinctive flavor and refined preparation. However, the mistranslation of 'traditional Khmer dish' as 'cold Khmer dish' is a notable semantic distortion because it changes the cultural characterization of the food. Pronoun use is mostly appropriate, and there are no fake transliterations, but the phrasing has several fluency and register issues.

per_sample.text: Nếu một người ngoài, lần đầu tiên đến ăn cùng gia đình tôi, họ có thể bất ngờ và ngạc nhiên vì cách ăn của gia đình.  Trước khi ăn, trẻ em phải mời và dâng cơm cho người lớn và  trong bữa ăn phải dùng muỗng múc, không được xới, quấy đồ ăn.
per_sample.question: Nếu một người ngoài lần đầu đến ăn cùng gia đình bạn, họ có thể bất ngờ hoặc ngạc nhiên vì điều gì trong cách mọi người ăn cùng nhau?
label: បើអ្នកខាងក្រៅមកញ៉ាំអាហារជាមួយគ្រួសារខ្ញុំជាលើកដំបូង គេប្រហែលជាភ្ញាក់ផ្អើល ជាមួយនឹងកិច្ចញ៉ាំបាយក្នុងគ្រួសារខ្ញុំ។ មុនពេលញ៉ាំ អ្នកវ័យតិចត្រូវអញ្ជើញ និងជូនចានបាយដល់មនុស្សធំ ហើយក្នុងអំឡុងពេលអាហារ ត្រូវប្រើស្លាបព្រាដើម្បីដួសអាហារ មិនត្រូវកូរ ឬកូរអាហារនោះទេ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ប្រសិនបើមានមនុស្សម្នាក់មកពីក្រៅ មកញ៉ាំជាមួយគ្រួសារខ្ញុំជាលើកដំបូង គេអាចនឹងភ្ញាក់ផ្អើលនិងអស់សំណើចដោយសារវិធីញ៉ាំរបស់គ្រួសារ។ មុនពេលញ៉ាំ ក្មេងត្រូវតែអញ្ជើញនិងដាក់បាយឲ្យមនុស្សធំ ហើយក្នុងពេលញ៉ាំត្រូវប្រើស្លាបព្រាចាប់ មិនត្រូវច្របាច់ ឬកូរអាហារ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Nếu người ngoài đến ăn cơm cùng gia đình tôi lần đầu tiên, họ có thể ngạc nhiên với cách ăn uống trong gia đình tôi. Trước khi ăn, người trẻ phải mời và dâng chén cơm cho người lớn, và trong suốt bữa ăn, phải dùng muỗng để lấy thức ăn, không được khuấy hay đảo thức ăn đó.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the broad scenario: an outsider eats with the speaker's family for the first time, may react unexpectedly, children invite/serve rice to adults before eating, and spoon use is required during the meal. However, there are notable semantic deviations. The phrase "អស់សំណើច" means being amused or finding something funny, which does not faithfully match "ngạc nhiên" / surprise or amazement. "ដាក់បាយឲ្យមនុស្សធំ" conveys placing or giving rice to adults but weakens the respectful sense of "dâng cơm" represented in the reference by "ជូនចានបាយ". The phrase "ប្រើស្លាបព្រាចាប់" is semantically inaccurate for using a spoon to scoop food; Khmer would require something like "ដួស". Finally, "ច្របាច់" means squeeze/crush and does not accurately correspond to "xới". The main message remains recoverable, but several content details are distorted.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses generally acceptable participant references: "មនុស្សម្នាក់មកពីក្រៅ" for an outside person, "គេ" for the third-person subject, "ក្មេង" for children, and "មនុស្សធំ" for adults. These are pragmatically understandable in Khmer. However, the culturally respectful act of children offering rice to adults is somewhat flattened by "ដាក់បាយឲ្យ", which is less deferential than "ជូន" or a stronger respectful offering construction. Still, there is no serious pronoun violation or culturally offensive form.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: There is no evidence of fake Vietnamese-to-Khmer phonetic character-copying or incoherent transliteration. All lexical items are recognizable Khmer words. However, several words are lexically legitimate but contextually inaccurate: "អស់សំណើច" for amazement, "ចាប់" with spoon use, and "ច្របាច់" for the prohibition against stirring/turning over food. These are real Khmer forms, not transliteration artifacts, but they reduce translation quality through wrong lexical selection.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence structure is mostly grammatical and readable in Khmer. The conditional opening, temporal sequencing, and coordination are coherent. However, "ប្រើស្លាបព្រាចាប់" is an unnatural collocation and disrupts native morpho-syntactic and lexical flow. The final prohibition phrase is structurally understandable but semantically awkward because of the verb choice "ច្របាច់". Overall, the syntax is serviceable but not fully natural.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is not unusable and communicates the general social situation, but it contains multiple notable semantic and lexical inaccuracies. The most serious issues are the mistranslation of surprise/amaze as amusement, the weakened respectful act of offering rice, and the incorrect verbs for spoon-scooping and not disturbing food. Pronoun and participant handling is mostly acceptable, and there are no fake transliterations. This places the translation in the fair-to-good range depending on dimension, with semantic fidelity weaker than grammaticality and lexical legitimacy.

per_sample.text: Bữa ăn tối thời ông bà khác hơn nhiều so với bây giờ, trước đây mọi ngường thường ăn mùm bong khlanh uống trà bây giờ các món ăn cầu kì đa dạng hơn.
per_sample.question: Bữa tối thời ông bà bạn khác gì so với bây giờ? Có món nào đã biến mất không? Bạn có thấy tiếc không?
label: អាហារពេលល្ងាចនៅសម័យជីដូនជីតារបស់យើងគឺខុសពីពេលនេះទៅទៀត ពីមុនប្រជាជនតែងតែហូបនំបង់ខ្លាញ់ផឹកទឹកតែ តែឥឡូវមុខម្ហូបមានភាពចម្រុះនិងទំនើបជាង។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អាហារពេលល្ងាចសម័យអ៊ំអ៊ំយាយយាយខុសពីឥឡូវនេះច្រើនណាស់ មុននេះគេតែងតែញ៉ាំមុំបុងខ្លាញ់ផឹកតែឥឡូវនេះម្ហូបអាហារមានភាពស្មុគស្មាញនិងចម្រុះជាងមុន។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Bữa ăn tối thời ông bà của chúng ta khác với bây giờ, trước đây người dân thường ăn bánh bông lan béo và uống trà, nhưng hiện nay các món ăn đa dạng và hiện đại hơn.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the broad core message: dinners in the grandparents'/older generation's time were very different from now; people formerly ate a traditional item and drank tea; foods today are more varied/elaborate. However, the culturally specific food item is mistransferred as "មុំបុងខ្លាញ់" instead of the reference's "នំបង់ខ្លាញ់", which weakens informational fidelity because the named dish is a key detail. The rendering of "cầu kì" as "ស្មុគស្មាញ" conveys complexity but can imply complication rather than refinement/elaborateness; still, it is partially acceptable. Overall meaning is recoverable but not fully accurate.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses "គេ" for general people, which is acceptable in colloquial Khmer for an unspecified collective subject. However, "សម័យអ៊ំអ៊ំយាយយាយ" is pragmatically and kinship-wise awkward compared with the reference's appropriate "សម័យជីដូនជីតារបស់យើង". It does not severely breach respect norms, but it does not accurately reflect the intended grandparents/ancestors framing.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Most vocabulary is legitimate Khmer: "អាហារពេលល្ងាច", "ខុសពី", "ញ៉ាំ", "ផឹកតែ", "ម្ហូបអាហារ", "ចម្រុះ". The major problem is "មុំបុងខ្លាញ់", which appears to be a raw/incorrect phonetic rendering from the Vietnamese source spelling rather than the authentic Khmer food term "នំបង់ខ្លាញ់" in the human reference. This is a clear lexical legitimacy issue involving a culturally specific item.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally understandable and mostly follows Khmer word order. However, it is run-on and lacks clear conjunction/punctuation between "ផឹកតែ" and "ឥឡូវនេះ", making the transition less natural. The phrase "សម័យអ៊ំអ៊ំយាយយាយ" is also syntactically and idiomatically awkward. Still, the overall structure remains readable.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis communicates the general contrast between past and present eating practices, but it contains a significant lexical error in the traditional food name and an awkward kinship expression for the grandparents' generation. There are no widespread gibberish strings, and the message is recoverable, but the cultural/lexical precision is below professional quality.

per_sample.text: Với đặc điểm đơn giản, dễ bảo quản, làm bởi gạo, nếp ngon lại no lâu. Do đó Nùm bong khlanh là được người dân Khmer yêu thích.
per_sample.question: Khi đi học về hoặc sau buổi làm đồng, người dân có thói quen ăn vặt món gì để lấy lại năng lượng?
label: ដោយមានលក្ខណៈសាមញ្ញ ងាយស្រួលរក្សាទុក ផលិតពីអង្ករ ឬដំណើប ឆ្ងាញ់ឆ្អែតបានយូរ។ អាស្រ័យហេតុនេះ នំបង់ខ្លាញ់ត្រូវបានប្រជាជនខ្មែរចូលចិត្តហូប។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: Nùm bong khlanh có đặc điểm đơn giản, dễ bảo quản, làm từ gạo, nếp ngon lại no lâu. Vì vậy, món này được người Khmer rất ưa chuộng.
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Với đặc điểm đơn giản, dễ bảo quản, được làm từ gạo hoặc nếp, ngon và để được lâu. Vì lý do này, bánh bò được người Khmer ưa thích ăn.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves most of the propositional content of the source and the human reference: Nùm bong khlanh is described as simple, easy to preserve, made from rice/glutinous rice, tasty, filling for a long time, and therefore liked by Khmer people. Minor differences include rendering the liking as 'rất ưa chuộng' rather than the reference's more specific 'ចូលចិត្តហូប' meaning 'like to eat', and the hypothesis does not clearly mark 'rice or glutinous rice' as an alternative. However, the major informational problem is that the hypothesis remains in Vietnamese rather than translating into Khmer like the reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no complex pronouns, kinship terms, Buddhist honorifics, or hierarchical address forms in this sentence. The phrase 'người Khmer' corresponds semantically to 'ប្រជាជនខ្មែរ'. Pragmatically, there is no serious subject-reference distortion. However, because the hypothesis is not in Khmer, it does not realize the Khmer reference's target-language social phrasing.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses Vietnamese/Latin-script vocabulary throughout: 'có đặc điểm đơn giản', 'dễ bảo quản', 'làm từ gạo, nếp', 'người Khmer rất ưa chuộng'. This is not fake Khmer transliteration, but it is also not a Khmer translation. The item name 'Nùm bong khlanh' is a Latin-script rendering of the Khmer food name, whereas the reference uses authentic Khmer script 'នំបង់ខ្លាញ់'. Therefore, lexical legitimacy as a Khmer target output is very weak due to wholesale source-language retention.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: As Vietnamese, the hypothesis is fluent and natural. However, against the Khmer human reference, it fails to provide Khmer morpho-syntactic structure, Khmer word order, or Khmer function-word usage. The sentence therefore cannot be considered a native Khmer rendering despite being readable Vietnamese.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is semantically close to the source/reference at the level of basic meaning, but it fails the central translation requirement because the expected target is Khmer and the output remains Vietnamese. There are no severe pronoun or cultural-honorific errors, but the absence of Khmer lexical and syntactic realization substantially lowers the morpho-syntactic and lexical legitimacy scores.

per_sample.text: Mắm bò hóc (Pro-hốc) là món ăn khá đặc trưng mà hiện nay giới trẻ người Khmer ở Đồng bằng sông Cửu Long rất yêu thích, vì thể hiện công phu, sáng tạo và đôi tay khéo léo bà người nấu.
per_sample.question: Những món ăn vặt truyền thống có còn phổ biến trong giới trẻ dân tộc bạn không? Vì sao có hoặc không?
label: ម៉មប្រហុក គឺជាមុខម្ហូបធម្មតាមួយមុខ ដែលបច្ចុប្បន្នកំពុងពេញនិយមយ៉ាងខ្លាំងក្នុងចំណោមយុវជនខ្មែរនៅតំបន់ដីសណ្តទន្លេមេគង្គ ព្រោះវាបង្ហាញពីភាពល្អិតល្អន់ ភាពច្នៃប្រឌិត និងជំនាញនៃដៃចុងភៅ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ប្រហុក (Pro-hốc) គឺជាម្ហូបដែលមានលក្ខណៈពិសេសមួយ ដែលបច្ចុប្បន្នយុវជនជនជាតិខ្មែរនៅតំបន់ដូងប៉ៃនៃដូងសូងគូឡុងចូលចិត្តខ្លាំងណាស់ ព្រោះវាបង្ហាញពីការប្រកបដោយសិល្បៈ ការបង្កើតថ្មី និងដៃដ៏ស្ទាត់ជំនាញរបស់អ្នកធ្វើម្ហូប។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Mắm bồ hóc là một món ăn bình thường nhưng hiện đang rất phổ biến trong giới trẻ Khmer ở vùng đồng bằng sông Cửu Long, vì nó thể hiện sự tinh tế, sáng tạo và kỹ năng của người đầu bếp.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the broad informational frame: the dish is described as distinctive/special, currently liked by Khmer youth, and associated with artistry/creativity/skilled hands in cooking. However, there are notable semantic losses and distortions. The reference renders the dish as “ម៉មប្រហុក,” while the hypothesis reduces it to “ប្រហុក,” which may be culturally related but is less specific than the reference. The most serious semantic error is the location: “Đồng bằng sông Cửu Long” should correspond to the Mekong Delta, as in the reference “តំបន់ដីសណ្តទន្លេមេគង្គ,” but the hypothesis gives a corrupted phonetic rendering “តំបន់ដូងប៉ៃនៃដូងសូងគូឡុង,” which does not accurately convey the place name in Khmer. The phrase for ‘meticulousness/craftsmanship’ is also shifted toward ‘artistry,’ which is partially related but not fully equivalent.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no major pronoun or kinship-term issues. The phrase “យុវជនជនជាតិខ្មែរ” appropriately identifies Khmer youth, and “អ្នកធ្វើម្ហូប” is pragmatically acceptable for the cook. No religious or hierarchical honorific context is mishandled. The subject references are socially neutral and acceptable in this context.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis contains a serious fake/awkward transliteration problem. “ដូងប៉ៃនៃដូងសូងគូឡុង” appears to be a phonetic copying of Vietnamese “Đồng bằng sông Cửu Long” rather than a legitimate Khmer rendering. This is not an accepted Khmer Krom regional lexical form and creates nonsensical or misleading Khmer wording. The retained Latin parenthetical “(Pro-hốc)” is also less natural than the fully Khmer reference form, though less damaging than the corrupted location phrase. Other vocabulary such as “ប្រហុក,” “យុវជន,” “ចូលចិត្ត,” and “អ្នកធ្វើម្ហូប” is legitimate Khmer.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The overall sentence structure is mostly understandable and follows a reasonable Khmer order: topic/dish + description + popularity among youth + causal explanation. However, the malformed location phrase disrupts fluency significantly. Some expressions are also slightly literal or awkward, such as “ការប្រកបដោយសិល្បៈ” for the intended sense of careful craftsmanship/meticulousness. The syntax is not broken overall, but it is less natural than the human reference.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is partially successful because the main theme remains recoverable: a Khmer food item is popular among Khmer youth and reflects skill and creativity in cooking. However, the corrupted rendering of the Mekong Delta is a critical defect, both semantically and lexically, because it replaces a standard geographic term with fake phonetic Khmer-like text. The dish name is also less specific than the reference. Pronoun and social-pragmatic handling is acceptable, but lexical legitimacy and semantic fidelity are notably weakened by the mistransliterated location.

per_sample.text: Mình đã từng chứng kiến ngoại rầy đứa em gai vì nấu sai món truyền thống. Ngoại nói nếu khi nấu sai hay thiếu nguyên liệu thì sẽ không thể hiện được món ăn đặc trưng.
per_sample.question: Bạn đã từng chứng kiến ai đó bị rầy vì nấu sai món truyền thống chưa? Vì sao điều đó lại quan trọng?
label: ធ្លាប់ឃើញយាយខ្ញុំស្តីបន្ទោសប្អូនស្រីខ្ញុំថា ធ្វើម្ហូបប្រពៃណីមិនត្រឹមត្រូវ។ យាយថាបើគ្រឿងផ្សំខុសឬបាត់មុខម្ហូបនឹងមិនអាចបង្ហាញពីភាពដើមរបស់មុខម្ហូបនោះបានឡើយ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្ញុំបានឃើញអ៊ំស្ដីប្អូនស្រីព្រោះធ្វើម្ហូបខុស។ អ៊ំនិយាយថាបើធ្វើខុសឬខ្វះគ្រឿងផ្សំ នោះនឹងមិនបង្ហាញបានរសជាតិពិសេសរបស់ម្ហូប។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Tôi đã từng thấy bà nội của tôi trách mắng em gái tôi rằng nấu món ăn truyền thống không đúng cách. Bà nói rằng nếu nguyên liệu sai hoặc thiếu thì món ăn sẽ không thể hiện được bản chất gốc của nó.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the broad event structure: the speaker witnessed an older relative scolding the younger sister because the dish was made incorrectly, followed by an explanation about incorrect cooking or missing ingredients reducing what the dish can express. However, there are notable semantic losses and shifts. The reference specifies 'យាយខ្ញុំ' / grandmother, while the hypothesis uses 'អ៊ំ', changing the family role. It also omits 'ម្ហូបប្រពៃណី' / traditional dish in the first sentence, reducing the cultural specificity. The final idea is shifted from 'showing the original/distinctive character of that dish' to 'showing the special taste of the food', which is related but narrower and not fully equivalent.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis has a significant kinship-term error. The source and reference identify the scolding person as 'ngoại' / maternal grandmother, rendered appropriately in the reference as 'យាយខ្ញុំ'. The hypothesis uses 'អ៊ំ', which refers to an older aunt/uncle-like kin term and does not preserve the grandmother relationship. This affects social hierarchy and family pragmatics. 'ប្អូនស្រី' is appropriate for younger sister, but the key elder kinship term is incorrect.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The lexical choices are legitimate Khmer vocabulary and do not show fake phonetic transliteration or character-copying from Vietnamese. Terms such as 'ស្ដី', 'ប្អូនស្រី', 'គ្រឿងផ្សំ', and 'ម្ហូប' are authentic. The issue is not lexical legitimacy but semantic precision, especially 'អ៊ំ' for 'យាយ' and 'រសជាតិពិសេស' for the more culturally grounded 'ភាពដើមរបស់មុខម្ហូប'.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence structure is generally grammatical and understandable in Khmer. Word order is natural enough: subject + verb + object + reason clause, followed by a conditional construction with 'បើ...នោះ'. Some phrasing is slightly compressed and less elegant than the reference, especially 'បើធ្វើខុស' without a clear object and 'នោះនឹងមិនបង្ហាញបានរសជាតិពិសេស', but the flow remains intelligible.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is understandable and contains no corrupted or fake transliterated forms. However, it makes a culturally and pragmatically important kinship error by translating grandmother as 'អ៊ំ', omits the traditional nature of the dish, and slightly distorts the final cultural meaning from displaying the dish's original/distinctive character to displaying its special taste. Therefore, semantic fidelity is fair, pronoun/kinship appropriateness is poor, morpho-syntax is good, and lexical legitimacy is excellent.

per_sample.text: Nếu nói về món ăn truyền thống được một người thân trong gia đình nấu nhiều nhất đó chính là bà tôi. Bởi vì khi nấu ăn bà là người thường xuyên gắn liền với những công thức nấu ăn cổ xưa, gìn giữ hương vị truyền thống và truyền lại cho thế hệ sau bằng tất cả tình yêu thương và sự chăm chú tỉ mỉ.
per_sample.question: Nếu món ăn truyền thống là một người thân trong gia đình, nó sẽ là ai – người mẹ, người bà, hay ông nội?
label: បើនិយាយអំពីមុខម្ហូបប្រពៃណីដែលក្នុងគ្រួសារបានម្នាក់ចម្អិនច្រើនជាងគេ គឺលោកយាយខ្ញុំ។ ដោយសារតែពេលធ្វើម្ហូប យាយតែងតែប្រកាន់ខ្ជាប់នូវរូបមន្តធ្វើម្ហូបបុរាណ រក្សានូវរសជាតិបែបប្រពៃណី និងចែកចាយបន្តទៅកាន់នាក់ជំនាន់ក្រោយដោយក្តីស្រលាញ់ និង ការយកចិត្តទុកដាក់បំផុត។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: បើនិយាយអំពីម្ហូបអាហារប្រពៃណីដែលមានមនុស្សម្នាក់ក្នុងគ្រួសារច្រើនជាងគេនោះគឺជាយាយខ្ញុំ។ ព្រោះពេលចំអិនអាហារយាយគឺជាមនុស្សដែលតែងតែភ្ជាប់ជាមួយនឹងរូបមន្តចំអិនអាហារបុរាណ រក្សារសជាតិប្រពៃណី និងបង្រៀនទៅកាន់ជំនាន់ក្រោយដោយសេចក្តីស្រឡាញ់ទាំងអស់ និងការយកចិត្តទុកដាក់យ៉ាងម៉ត់ចត់។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Khi nói về món ăn truyền thống mà trong gia đình có một người nấu nhiều nhất, đó là bà ngoại tôi. Bởi vì khi nấu ăn, bà luôn tuân thủ nghiêm ngặt công thức nấu ăn cổ truyền, giữ nguyên hương vị truyền thống và truyền lại cho thế hệ sau với tình yêu thương và sự tận tâm nhất.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the overall core message: the speaker’s grandmother is associated with traditional cooking, old recipes, preservation of traditional taste, and transmission to later generations with love and careful attention. However, the first sentence is semantically incomplete/awkward because it says roughly “traditional food that has one person in the family the most,” omitting or obscuring the key verb “cooked.” The phrase “បង្រៀនទៅកាន់ជំនាន់ក្រោយ” means “teach to the next generation,” which is close to but slightly narrower than “pass on/transmit.” Overall meaning remains recoverable with minor-to-moderate distortion in the opening clause.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The kinship term “យាយខ្ញុំ” is appropriate for “my grandmother” and culturally acceptable, though the Human Reference uses the more respectful “លោកយាយខ្ញុំ” initially. The later use of “យាយ” is consistent with the reference and does not violate Khmer/Krom pragmatic norms. No serious pronoun or honorific misuse occurs.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer lexical items such as “ម្ហូបអាហារប្រពៃណី,” “រូបមន្តចំអិនអាហារបុរាណ,” “រសជាតិប្រពៃណី,” and “ការយកចិត្តទុកដាក់យ៉ាងម៉ត់ចត់.” There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese or corrupted character-copying. Lexical choices are authentic, though some are slightly literal or less idiomatic than the reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence structure is generally understandable, but the opening relative clause is syntactically weak because it lacks a clear cooking predicate. “យាយគឺជាមនុស្សដែលតែងតែភ្ជាប់ជាមួយនឹង...” is also somewhat literal and less natural than the reference’s “យាយតែងតែប្រកាន់ខ្ជាប់នូវ...”. Still, the second sentence flows adequately and preserves Khmer word order reasonably well.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a mostly understandable Khmer translation with the main cultural and informational content preserved. The strongest area is lexical legitimacy, as the text uses real Khmer vocabulary and no fake transliterations. The main weaknesses are the malformed first clause and some literal phrasing, especially around “associated with recipes” and “teach to later generations.” Pronoun and kinship usage is acceptable, though slightly less respectful than the reference’s initial “លោកយាយ.”

per_sample.text: Mẹ tôi là người thường sử dụng các dụng cụ nấu ăn trong gia đình, không phân chia dụng cụ nam hay nữ , bởi vì các dụng cụ đó đều phù hợp với thành viên trong gia đình khi cần thiết.
per_sample.question: Ai thường là người sử dụng các dụng cụ nấu ăn trong gia đình bạn – có phân chia giữa nam và nữ không? Vì sao?
label: ម្តាយខ្ញុំជាមនុស្សម្នាក់ដែលតែងតែប្រើប្រដាប់ធ្វើម្ហូបក្នុងគ្រួសារដោយមិនបែងចែករវាងប្រដាប់ភេទប្រុស និងប្រដាប់ភេទស្រី ព្រោះប្រដាប់ទាំងនោះ សុទ្ធតែស័ក្តិសមសម្រាប់សមាជិកគ្រួសារនៅពេលត្រូវការ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ម៉ែខយ់លាអ្នកធូងស៊ូយឌូងកាកឌូងគូណោអ៊ានណងកាដាំលីង, ឃោងផនជាឌូងគូណាមហៃណូ, ប៉ៃវ៉ីកាកឌូងគូណោតែវ៉ូហ៊ូបហៃវៀនណងកាដាំលីងខយ់កន់ធេត.
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Mẹ tôi là người luôn sử dụng các dụng cụ nấu ăn trong gia đình mà không phân biệt giữa dụng cụ dành cho nam và dụng cụ dành cho nữ, vì tất cả những dụng cụ đó đều phù hợp cho các thành viên trong gia đình khi cần thiết.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis does not provide a meaningful Khmer translation of the source/reference. Although it appears to loosely follow the Vietnamese source sequence phonetically, the content is not intelligible as Khmer. Core informational units such as 'mother', 'cooking utensils', 'not divided by male/female', and 'suitable for family members when necessary' are not semantically conveyed in authentic Khmer. The meaning is therefore not reliably recoverable for a Khmer reader.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The reference uses the appropriate Khmer expression 'ម្តាយខ្ញុំ' for 'my mother'. The hypothesis begins with 'ម៉ែខយ់', where 'ម៉ែ' can be a legitimate colloquial/regional form for mother, but 'ខយ់' is not an appropriate Khmer possessive/pronoun form here and appears to be a phonetic rendering of Vietnamese 'tôi'. The broader sentence lacks proper Khmer pronominal and relational structure.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis is dominated by fake phonetic transliterations of Vietnamese into Khmer script: e.g., 'លា' for 'là', 'ធូងស៊ូយ' for 'thường sử dụng', 'ឌូងគូ' for 'dụng cụ', 'ណោអ៊ាន' for 'nấu ăn', 'កាដាំលីង' for 'gia đình', 'ឃោងផនជា' for 'không phân chia', 'ប៉ៃវ៉ី' for 'bởi vì', and 'ហ៊ូបហៃ' for 'phù hợp'. These are not authentic Khmer or Khmer Krom lexical items. Apart from isolated forms like 'ម៉ែ' and 'អ្នក', the output is largely unusable as Khmer.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The word order follows the Vietnamese source mechanically rather than Khmer syntax. Because most lexical items are non-Khmer phonetic strings, there is no coherent Khmer morpho-syntactic structure. The sentence does not flow naturally and cannot be parsed as a grammatical Khmer sentence.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a severe translation failure. The hypothesis is almost entirely a raw Vietnamese-to-Khmer-script phonetic transcription rather than a legitimate Khmer translation. It fails semantic transfer, uses inappropriate pronoun/possessive forms, lacks Khmer grammatical structure, and contains extensive fake transliteration. Under the rubric, this corresponds to an unusable output.

per_sample.text: Lúc còn nhỏ Tôi được ông ngoại kể chuyện xưa cho nghe trước khi ngủ, ông thường chọn những câu chuyện dân gian cho chúng tôi nghe, đôi lúc ông kể những chuyện liên quan đến đức Phật Thích ca Mâu ni.
per_sample.question: Trong bữa tối, có ai kể chuyện xưa, dạy con cháu về phong tục, lịch sử dân tộc không?
label: កាលខ្ញុំនៅតូច ជីតារបស់ខ្ញុំនិទានរឿងមុនពេលខ្ញុំចូលគេង គាត់ជ្រើសរើសរឿងប្រជាប្រិយមកនិទានសម្រាប់យើងស្តាប់ ជួនកាលគាត់និទានរឿងទាក់ទងនឹងព្រះសម្មាសម្ពុទ្ធផងដែរ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ពេលតូច ខ្ញុំបានស្តាប់រឿងពីតា មុនពេលគេង។ តាម្នាក់ៗតាមរឿងប្រពៃណីឲ្យយើងស្តាប់។ ពេលខ្លះ តាបាននិយាយអំពីព្រះពុទ្ធសាក្យមុនី។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Khi tôi còn nhỏ, ông nội thường kể chuyện trước khi tôi đi ngủ. Ông chọn những câu chuyện dân gian để kể cho chúng tôi nghe, đôi khi ông cũng kể những câu chuyện liên quan đến Đức Phật.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the broad autobiographical frame: when the speaker was small, they listened to stories from the grandfather before sleeping, and sometimes the grandfather spoke about the Buddha/Shakyamuni. However, several informational details are weakened or lost. The source/reference says the grandfather narrated old stories and often selected folk/popular tales for the children to hear; the hypothesis renders this second proposition in a malformed way and does not clearly preserve the idea of 'often choosing' stories. The phrase about stories related to the Buddha is simplified to 'spoke about the Buddha Shakyamuni,' which is understandable but less faithful to the reference's 'narrated stories related to the Buddha.' Overall, the core message is recoverable, but there is a notable semantic degradation in the middle sentence.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of ខ្ញុំ for 'I' is appropriate. The use of តា for grandfather is colloquial but legitimate in Khmer and can be acceptable in regional/familial contexts, including Khmer Krom usage; it should not be penalized as culturally invalid. The reference uses ជីតា, which is somewhat more explicit/formal. The hypothesis maintains respectful Buddhist reference with ព្រះពុទ្ធសាក្យមុនី, which is acceptable, though the verb និយាយអំពី is less narratively and reverentially aligned than និទានរឿងទាក់ទងនឹង in the reference. There is no major pronoun violation, but the social-pragmatic tone is slightly less polished.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or raw Vietnamese character-copying. Terms such as តា, រឿងប្រពៃណី, ព្រះពុទ្ធសាក្យមុនី are legitimate Khmer lexical items or Buddhist vocabulary. The problematic sequence តាម្នាក់ៗតាមរឿង appears to be a syntactic/word-choice malfunction, not a fake transliteration. Lexical legitimacy is therefore largely intact.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The first sentence is mostly natural, though somewhat compressed. The third sentence is also grammatical and understandable. The major issue is the second sentence: តាម្នាក់ៗតាមរឿងប្រពៃណីឲ្យយើងស្តាប់ is morpho-syntactically defective and does not naturally express 'he often selected folk stories to tell us.' The repetition/sequence តា...តាម... creates confusion and disrupts the flow. This significantly lowers syntactic quality despite the rest being readable.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is not unusable: the main scene and some core content are understandable. It also uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary and acceptable kinship/Buddhist terms. However, compared with the human reference, it loses the habitual selection of folk tales, weakens the narration frame, and contains a seriously malformed middle sentence. Thus, semantic fidelity is fair, pronoun and cultural handling are good, lexical legitimacy is strong, but morpho-syntactic flow is poor to fair due to the central grammatical breakdown.

per_sample.text: Theo tôi, điều đang khiến các món ăn truyền thống bị mai một đó là:  1. Sự thay đổi trong lối sống hiện đại dẫn đến các món ăn nhanh; 2. Thiếu sự truyền dạy từ thế hệ trước; 3. Sự xuất hiện của các món ăn ngoại nhập.
per_sample.question: Theo bạn, điều gì đang khiến các món ăn truyền thống mai một?
label: តាមគំនិតរបស់ខ្ញុំយល់ឃើញថាហេតុដែលធ្វើឱ្យមុខម្ហូបបែបប្រពៃណីបាត់បង់គឺ៖  ទី១-ការផ្លាស់ប្តូររបៀបរស់នៅបែបទំនើប ដែលនាំឱ្យអាហាររហ័ស។ ទី២-កង្វះការបង្រៀនពីជំនាន់មុន។ ទី៣-ការលេចឡើងនៃមុខម្ហូបបរទេស។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: តាមខ្ញុំគិត វត្ថុដែលកំពុងធ្វើឲ្យម្ហូបប្រពៃណីកំពុងបាត់បង់នោះគឺ៖ ១. ការផ្លាស់ប្តូរនៅក្នុងរបៀបរស់នៅសម័យទំនើបនាំឲ្យមានម្ហូបរហ័ស; ២. ខ្វះការបង្រៀនពីជំនាន់មុន; ៣. ការបង្ហាញនៃម្ហូបបរទេស។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Theo ý kiến của tôi, lý do khiến các món ăn truyền thống bị mai một là: Thứ nhất, sự thay đổi lối sống hiện đại dẫn đến thức ăn nhanh. Thứ hai, thiếu sự truyền dạy từ thế hệ trước. Thứ ba, sự xuất hiện của các món ăn nước ngoài.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the three main causal factors: modern lifestyle change leading to fast food, lack of transmission from the previous generation, and foreign foods. The overall informational structure and enumeration are intact. However, there are minor semantic weaknesses: “វត្ថុដែលកំពុងធ្វើឲ្យ...” is a literal rendering of “điều” and sounds less natural than “ហេតុដែល...”; “ការបង្ហាញនៃម្ហូបបរទេស” means more like “the showing/display of foreign foods,” whereas the intended meaning is “the emergence/appearance” of foreign foods. This slightly distorts the third point but does not destroy recoverability.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The first-person expression “តាមខ្ញុំគិត” appropriately reflects “Theo tôi” and does not introduce any culturally inappropriate pronoun or honorific issue. There are no kinship, religious, or hierarchy-sensitive terms in this sentence requiring special Khmer Krom pragmatic marking. The pronoun choice is acceptable and socially neutral.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis does not contain fake phonetic transliterations or character-copying from Vietnamese. Vocabulary such as “ការផ្លាស់ប្តូរ,” “របៀបរស់នៅ,” “សម័យទំនើប,” “ជំនាន់មុន,” and “ម្ហូបបរទេស” is legitimate Khmer. Some lexical choices are less ideal, especially “វត្ថុ” for the abstract causal “điều” and “ការបង្ហាញ” for “sự xuất hiện,” but these are authentic Khmer words rather than illegitimate transliterations.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The syntax is generally understandable and follows Khmer word order, but it is somewhat literal and repetitive. The phrase “វត្ថុដែលកំពុងធ្វើឲ្យម្ហូបប្រពៃណីកំពុងបាត់បង់” is awkward because of the repeated “កំពុង” and the use of “វត្ថុ” for an abstract cause. “នាំឲ្យមានម្ហូបរហ័ស” is comprehensible, though “អាហាររហ័ស” would be more idiomatic for fast food. Overall flow is acceptable but not fully native-like.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a good translation with the main message preserved and no serious cultural or pronoun errors. It is not a professional/native match because of literal phrasing, repetition, and one notable lexical-semantic weakness in translating “sự xuất hiện” as “ការបង្ហាញ.” There is no evidence of fake transliteration, and the translation remains fully intelligible.

per_sample.text: Nếu phải chọn một món ăn để giới thiệu về bữa ăn trưa truyền thống của dân tộc mình với thế giới, tôi sẽ giới thiệu món canh Som-lo Co Cô, bởi vì nó dễ tìm và ít tốn chi phí nó có đủ loại rau vườn, cá thịt, mắm bò hóc, và các loại gia vị khác.

label: ប្រសិនបើខ្ញុំត្រូវជ្រើសរើសមុខម្ហូបមួយមុខ ដើម្បីណែនាំអាហារថ្ងៃត្រង់ប្រពៃណីរបស់ប្រជាជនខ្ញុំទៅកាន់ពិភពលោក ខ្ញុំនឹងជ្រើសយកសម្លកកូរដើម្បីណែនាំអំពីមុខម្ហូបទំនៀមទម្លាប់ពីព្រោះមុខម្ហូបនេះងាយរកនិងអត់សូវចំណាយលុយច្រើនហើយវាផ្សំបន្លែស្រែគ្រប់មុខត្រីសាច់ប្រហុកគ្រឿងទេសផ្សេងៗទៀត។
